articles.summary: Curbline Properties Corp. (NYSE: CURB), an owner of convenience centers in suburban, high household income communities, declared today a third quarter 2026 dividend on its common stock of $0.17 per share. The dividend is payable on October 14, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on September 29, 2026.
